title: Why Static Probes Fail: Context Determines Deception Feature Composition
abstract: arXiv:2610.27577v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With increasing autonomy, Large Language Models (LLMs) may engage in deceptive behaviors, such as scheming to pursue misaligned goals or sandbagging to escape oversight. Monitoring outputs alone is insufficient, as models can produce seemingly benign responses while harboring misaligned internal objectives. While mechanistic approaches like linear probing are promising, they rely on the assumption that deception corresponds to a single direction in representation space. We demonstrate that such single-direction probes fail to generalize across diverse deception scenarios. To bridge this gap, we propose representing deception as a multi-dimensional subspace rather than a single direction. Our method utilizes iterative orthogonal decomposition to identify complementary directions that capture distinct facets of deceptive intent. translated_title: 为什么静态探针会失效：上下文决定欺骗特征的组成
translated_abstract: 随着自主性不断增强，大型语言模型（LLMs）可能会表现出欺骗性行为，例如为实现未对齐目标而密谋（scheming），或为逃避监督而故意示弱（sandbagging）。仅监控模型输出是不够的，因为模型可能在内部持有未对齐目标的同时产生看似无害的响应。虽然线性探针等机械可解释性方法颇具前景，但它们依赖于一个假设：欺骗对应于表征空间中的单一方向。我们证明，这类单方向探针无法在多样化的欺骗场景中泛化。为弥合这一差距，我们提出将欺骗表示为多维子空间而非单一方向。我们的方法利用迭代正交分解来识别互补方向，这些方向捕捉了欺骗意图的不同侧面。为了有效地利用这些方向进行检测，我们发现静态组合方式会变得脆弱……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现欺骗并非大语言模型表征空间中的单一方向，提出用迭代正交分解将欺骗建模为多维子空间，并揭示欺骗特征的组成依赖于上下文，因此静态的探针组合难以可靠泛化。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that deception is not a single direction in LLM representation space; it proposes modeling deception as a multi-dimensional subspace via iterative orthogonal decomposition, and reveals that the composition of deception features is context-dependent, making static probe combinations brittle.
